text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's time for today's Winning Live!!
Taking the center stage after a glorious victory is none other than—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Fusaichi Pandora!
Just how many G1 titles is that for her now?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe~, which one was this again~?
Seven, eight, nine... A whoooole bunch☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totally natural, right? I mean, I'm a genius after all♪
Mfufuuun, eheheeen!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mmmwah♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is so exciting♪
Yep, yep! I really am a total legend, aren't I♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehehehehe~... *drool*...
Pandora-san! Fusaichi Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eep?! Y-Yeeesh???

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It's "Yes", not "Yeeesh". Were you even listening?
If you were, please solve the problem on the blackboard.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The problem on the... blackboard...?
Umm, uhhh... The answer is...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just plug it right into ①, and BAM!
(x, y) = (3, 2)! ...Or somethin' like that?

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—!! ...That is correct.
It seems your brain is working just fine after all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aww, piece of cake, love and peace☆
Stuff like this is easy-peasy, even in my sleep♪

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text: Still! You must not sleep during class!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!!
Aww maaan, now I'm in troubleee~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(But hey~, even if I don't pay super close attention
in class, no sweat☆ After all, I'm...!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(A total genius who's gonna be a super big star
in the Twinkle Series one day♪)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was during the mock races that I happened
to catch sight of that particular horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaalrighty.
Guess I'll turn it on from here~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Heeeee-yaaaah! And BAM☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was barely coasting along. Yet her refined, effortless stride
was distinctly different from any other horsegirl on the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was unmistakable raw talent. However—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fusaichi Pandora! Why don't you sign a contract with me?
With talent like that, there's no need to wait for the debut races.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I am so popular, aren't I♡
Whatever should I do~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Usually, contracts between Trainers and horsegirls are formed
after watching their performances in the selection races. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For top-tier prospects, contracts are sometimes decided before then.
Getting scouted like this was proof of her potential, but...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Unmistakable talent, huh?
...Hah, as if.
choice_data_list: Huh... You don't think she's that good?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You'll see soon enough.
Just watch.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora, I want to see you run again.
Instead of coasting like before, could you try giving it your all this time?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My all...?
Okee-dokee☆ I'll do it my way, then♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twirling her hair, Fusaichi Pandora stood at the starting line,
and with lightning-like intensity, she took off—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Lalalaaa, ta-daaa~...☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She didn't run with lightning-like intensity at all.
She seemed to be trying a little harder than before, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha☆ I am crazy good!
When was the last time I tried this hard?!
choice_data_list: (That was her trying hard?! It barely looked any different...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whew, what a workout☆
Oh, I want some juice! Juice, juice♪

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: See? Told ya so.
choice_data_list: What was that run just now...?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
A horsegirl needs more than just raw talent.
No matter how good her legs or build might be...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If her head isn't in the game, it's meaningless. I wouldn't touch her.
Above all—I can't stand that lack of grit.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Could you try running properly, just one more time?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Properly? But I just did!
That was like, my best effort all year! Seriously, for real!!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, a bit more than that... Like, with more effort...
Please, just once more?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, don't worry, it's all good♪ I can totally win like that.
Races, classes, things always work out for me anyway☆

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
T-Then... Will you promise to put more effort into
racing in the future? If you can promise me that...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Well, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll pick someone else♪
I don't really know about stuff that far ahead anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She was like a marshmallow. No matter how much you begged
or pushed, nothing seemed to make an impression on her.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: *sniff* *sniff*... *sniff* *sniff* *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I smell something super sweet coming from over there...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did a crêpe stand pass by or something?
Fusaichi Pandora drifted over, wandering aimlessly until—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh, ehehehe~ Found youuu♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: This one!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you're a Trainer too, right?
In that case, won't you...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Scout me right now?
